cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you pinch these bouquet stems together? My wedding ribbon keeps sliding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got them. You need wire underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could you twist this bit round, just where your fingers are?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. That sharp end will snag the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tuck it in and wind the ribbon over it? One little bow would hide everything. I'll hold the scissors.

mechanism: A treats useful advice as an approved request to perform one more tiny bouquet task, gradually retaining only a supervisory role.
confusable: Openly assigning all bouquet work is not enough; each small favor must follow B contribution and quietly accumulate.
comparison: A skilled helper advice becomes wire and ribbon finishing, unlike the shelf scene time-limited release from holding.
seedUse: Use D25-b wire diagnosis and snagging end, with S01 approval turning each observation into authorized extra help.
